program: BIMLog stabilization, completion, and release program — 120 builds
owner: BIMLog MAIN04 under MAIN00 program oversight

entries.title: Production dependency advisories remain open
entries.acceptance: Every production advisory is fixed, proven unreachable, or retained with bounded evidence; no unreviewed high-severity production advisory remains.

entries.title: Lens release assertion is stale and red
entries.acceptance: Contract-driven current-version and stale/mixed-version negative tests pass without hard-coded P12 assumptions.

entries.title: Platform, Native, and package version identity is incoherent
entries.acceptance: Platform label, API metadata, Native constants, DLL metadata, package manifests, receipts, and compatibility tests derive from and agree with one executable contract.

entries.title: Rollback operator and current production restore receipt are incomplete
entries.acceptance: An executable bounded rollback and isolated restore rehearsal prove exact recovery identity, checksums, application readiness, and authenticated login for the release candidate.

entries.title: Living Brief and OPEN_LOOP contain stale current-state claims
entries.acceptance: Current truth is separated from history; all 126 unchecked items have a disposition and evidence; contradictions fail CI.

entries.title: Repository and worktree debt is material
entries.acceptance: All 142 worktrees and 61 ancestry-unmerged branches have reviewed dispositions; only accepted corrections enter clean program lineage.

entries.title: Canonical local checkout is dirty and stale
entries.acceptance: The canonical release checkout is clean, points to the authoritative lineage, and passes exact local/remote identity checks without deleting preserved evidence.

entries.title: Unfinished product candidates are distributed across worktrees
entries.acceptance: Every effective product change is integrated, proven superseded, or retained as evidence; no branch is accepted by name or commit count alone.

entries.title: Static platform audit reports 65 non-blocking P1 findings
entries.acceptance: Stable release-blocking categories have zero findings and each deferred P1 has an owner, rationale, evidence, and target build.

entries.title: Complete role and object-authorization matrix is not yet proven
entries.acceptance: Super Admin, PMO/Finance, project admin, member, denied-user, tenant, project, file, report, Lens, feedback, and integration matrices pass server-side and visible-route tests.

entries.title: Feedback composer and review route semantics are confusing
entries.acceptance: Help, deep links, route tests, and role behavior clearly distinguish /feedback composition from /admin/feedback review.

entries.title: GitHub main/master and canonical lineage are divergent
entries.acceptance: One canonical branch and release lineage is enforced by exact local/remote identity checks; stale heads cannot be selected as release source.

entries.title: Replit publication marker lacks a durable synchronization operator
entries.acceptance: A repeatable operator proves exact tree/source identity, preserves provider publication markers without treating them as product code, and emits a machine-readable receipt.

entries.title: Production database migration and checksum identity is not exposed in one release contract
entries.acceptance: Production schema, migration checksums, built assets, source commit, and publication receipt are bound and mismatch fails before publication.

entries.title: Repository release instructions contain stale force-push guidance
entries.acceptance: Documentation describes only the proven normal-push release path and contradiction checks reject stale force-push guidance.

entries.title: Automatic post-merge Helium synchronization is broader than the governed release path
entries.acceptance: Database synchronization runs only through the conditional guarded operator when schema correspondence proves it necessary; ordinary merges cannot mutate data.

entries.title: Release-lineage checker assumes stale origin/main authority
entries.acceptance: Lineage verification uses declared canonical authority and a valid tree/source relationship and is part of the normal pre-push gate.

entries.title: No single complete machine-readable release receipt exists
entries.acceptance: One validated receipt binds source, tree, assets, schema, provider publication, live identity, rollback, and smoke evidence with exact hashes.

entries.title: Live API does not independently expose immutable release identity
entries.acceptance: Safe diagnostics expose exact deployed commit/package/receipt identity, and browser acceptance fails when it reaches an old runtime.

entries.title: Current production restore evidence is not bound to the active publication
entries.acceptance: A fresh isolated backup/restore rehearsal is tied to the exact candidate and proves migration replay, readiness, and login.

entries.title: Named disposable workflow database fixtures are not deterministic
entries.acceptance: Delivery and economic-allocation HTTP fixtures create, execute, and clean up twice on Windows with correct UTF-8 identity and no shared-server residue.

entries.title: Lens Next real Navisworks field acceptance is open
entries.owner: BIMLog MAIN04 with Ruben field acceptance
entries.acceptance: Navisworks 2021/2025 pass create, camera, sectioning, Working View, XML, save/reopen, migration, real bounded 3D, and duplicate-loader checks on controlled model copies.

entries.title: Legacy Lens remains installed and Lens Next sole-product transition is incomplete
entries.acceptance: Customer surfaces and verified installers present only Lens Next; historical data migrates once; Legacy loaders are absent from Autodesk discovery roots while rollback evidence is preserved externally.

entries.title: Historical Job Intake financial mapping defect requires permanent regression
entries.acceptance: A fresh project cannot reproduce the whole-plan-price/unit-rate error; totals reconcile across input, persistence, display, and export while Project 50 evidence remains unchanged.

entries.title: Intended company pricing and PMO/Finance authority is not proven end to end
entries.owner: BIMLog MAIN04 with controlled Lorena acceptance
entries.acceptance: The intended PMO/Finance account completes catalog, pricing, Intake, APU, activation, Operations, and export workflows with correct role boundaries and persistence.

entries.title: Authenticated project pages lack consistent page-level h1 structure
entries.acceptance: Every audited route has one meaningful h1, correct landmarks, skip navigation, focus order, and reviewed viewport evidence.

entries.title: Unfinished features and customer-impacting paths lack final acceptance
entries.owner: BIMLog MAIN04 with controlled customer acceptance
entries.acceptance: Unsupported promises are implemented or removed; every formerly excluded mutation is exercised only in a controlled acceptance path with pre/post reconciliation, rollback, truthful result, and no unexplained skip.
